oecd_leo_2024.status: Plausibility comparison only; not non-agricultural per-worker evidence for 0.32

wdi_diagnostic.formula: P_nonag = P_all * (1 - agriculture_GDP_share) / (1 - agriculture_employment_share); ratio = P_nonag_LAC / P_nonag_OED
wdi_diagnostic.aggregation: Published WDI aggregates, not simple country averages. Membership and underlying country weights are inherited from this WDI release, not independently reconstructed. Indicator coverage/weights can differ; multiplying aggregate shares by PPP productivity is a diagnostic approximation, not a harmonised country-level sector PPP estimate.

conclusion: 0.32 retained as an explicit user-approved high-level modelling assumption, not an empirically reproduced 2023 non-agricultural estimate. Current WDI diagnostic and OECD per-hour evidence must not be relabelled as its derivation. Revised data do not reconstruct the unknown original chat data vintage.
